heading: Capital Gains Tax Exemption: How Section 54EC Bonds Can Help
tldr: Selling land or property can lead to significant long-term capital gains tax liabilities.
Section 54EC of the Income Tax Act offers an exemption if you reinvest these gains into specific bonds.
You must invest the capital gains within six months from the date of asset transfer.
The maximum investment allowed under this section for capital gains exemption is ₹50 lakhs.
These bonds come with a mandatory five-year lock-in period, and early withdrawal negates the tax benefit.
caption:
Sold property or land recently? You might be wondering about the tax on your profit. Good news! There's a smart way to save on that tax. Section 54EC bonds let you reinvest your gains and get an exemption, up to ₹50 lakhs. But you need to act within six months. Learn how these bonds can help you keep more of your money.
